import numpy as np, requests, os, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
D='/tmp/acc'; os.makedirs(D,exist_ok=True)

open(f'{D}/1B8G.pdb','w').write(S.get('https://files.rcsb.org/download/1B8G.pdb',timeout=120).text)
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}
def parse_pdb(path, chain=None):
    ca=[];het=[];allat=[];seen=set()
    for l in open(path):
        rec=l[:6]
        if rec not in ('ATOM  ','HETATM'): continue
        if l[16] not in (' ','A'): continue
        if l[76:78].strip()=='H': continue
        ch=l[21];resn=l[17:20].strip();resi=l[22:27].strip();name=l[12:16].strip()
        xyz=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])
        b=float(l[60:66]) if l[60:66].strip() else 0.0
        if chain and ch!=chain: continue
        if rec=='ATOM  ' or resn=='MSE':
            allat.append([ch,resi,resn,name,xyz,b])
            if name=='CA' and resn in AA3 and (ch,resi) not in seen:
                seen.add((ch,resi)); ca.append([ch,resi,resn,xyz,b])
        else: het.append([ch,resi,resn,name,xyz])
    return ca,het,allat
def seq_of(ca): return ''.join(AA3.get(r[2],'X') for r in ca)
B="""A R N D C Q E G H I L K M F P S T W Y V
A 4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0

Q -1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2

F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2

V 0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
ls=B.strip().split('\n');hd=ls[0].split();M62={}
for l in ls[1:]:
    p=l.split()
    for b,v in zip(hd,p[1:]): M62[(p[0],b)]=int(v)
idx={a:i for i,a in enumerate(hd)};SM=np.full((21,21),-2.0)
for (a,b),v in M62.items(): SM[idx[a],idx[b]]=v
def enc(s): return np.array([idx.get(c,20) for c in s])
def nw(s1,s2,go=-11,ge=-1):
    e1,e2=enc(s1),enc(s2);n,m=len(s1),len(s2);NEG=-1e9
    Mm=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    pM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);pX=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);pY=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    Mm[0,0]=0;Ix[1:,0]=go+ge*np.arange(n);pX[1:,0]=1;Iy[0,1:]=go+ge*np.arange(m);pY[0,1:]=2
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        srow=SM[e1[i-1],e2];Mp=Mm[i-1];Xp=Ix[i-1];Yp=Iy[i-1]
        A1=np.vstack([Mp[:-1],Xp[:-1],Yp[:-1]]);Mm[i,1:]=A1.max(0)+srow;pM[i,1:]=A1.argmax(0)
        A2=np.vstack([Mp[1:]+go,Xp[1:]+ge,Yp[1:]+go]);Ix[i,1:]=A2.max(0);pX[i,1:]=A2.argmax(0)
        Mi=Mm[i];Xi=Ix[i];Yi=Iy[i];Pi=pY[i]
        for jj in range(1,m+1):
            a=Mi[jj-1]+go;b=Xi[jj-1]+go;c=Yi[jj-1]+ge
            if a>=b and a>=c: Yi[jj]=a;Pi[jj]=0
            elif b>=c: Yi[jj]=b;Pi[jj]=1
            else: Yi[jj]=c;Pi[jj]=2
    i,jj=n,m;stt=int(np.argmax((Mm[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m])));pr=[]
    while i>0 and jj>0:
        if stt==0: pr.append((i-1,jj-1));stt=pM[i,jj];i-=1;jj-=1
        elif stt==1: stt=pX[i,jj];i-=1
        else: stt=pY[i,jj];jj-=1
    return pr[::-1]
def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc=P.mean(0);qc=Q.mean(0);H=(P-pc).T@(Q-qc);U,s,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    R=Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T))])@U.T
    return R,qc-R@pc
def dp(Dm,gap=-0.6):
    n,m=Dm.shape;F=np.zeros((n+1,m+1));P=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    F[1:,0]=np.arange(1,n+1)*gap;P[1:,0]=1;F[0,1:]=np.arange(1,m+1)*gap;P[0,1:]=2
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        Fi=F[i];Fp=F[i-1];Di=Dm[i-1]
        for jj in range(1,m+1):
            a=Fp[jj-1]+Di[jj-1];b=Fp[jj]+gap;c=Fi[jj-1]+gap
            if a>=b and a>=c: Fi[jj]=a;P[i,jj]=0
            elif b>=c: Fi[jj]=b;P[i,jj]=1
            else: Fi[jj]=c;P[i,jj]=2
    i,jj=n,m;pr=[]
    while i>0 and jj>0:
        p=P[i,jj]
        if p==0: pr.append((i-1,jj-1));i-=1;jj-=1
        elif p==1: i-=1
        else: jj-=1
    return pr[::-1]
def salign(A,Bc,seed,it=8):
    L=min(len(A),len(Bc));d0=1.24*(L-15)**(1/3)-1.8;pairs=seed;best=None
    for _ in range(it):
        P=np.array([A[i] for i,j2 in pairs]);Q=np.array([Bc[j2] for i,j2 in pairs])
        R,t=kabsch(P,Q);At=A@R.T+t
        d=np.linalg.norm(At[:,None,:]-Bc[None,:,:],axis=2);Ds=1/(1+(d/d0)**2)
        np_=dp(Ds);tm=sum(Ds[i,j2] for i,j2 in np_)/L
        core=[(i,j2) for i,j2 in np_ if d[i,j2]<5];rms=float(np.sqrt(np.mean([d[i,j2]**2 for i,j2 in core])))
        if best is None or tm>best[0]: best=(tm,R.copy(),t.copy(),list(np_),len(core),rms)
        if np_==pairs: break
        pairs=np_
    return best

# --- pseudo-dimer test: place each model on apple chain B, measure to chain A PLP ---
caB,hetB,allB=parse_pdb(f'{D}/1B8G.pdb','B')
caA,hetA,allA=parse_pdb(f'{D}/1B8G.pdb','A')
plpA=np.array([h[4] for h in hetA if h[2]=='PLP'])
seqB=seq_of(caB); cB=np.array([r[3] for r in caB]); resiB=[r[1] for r in caB]; resnB=[r[2] for r in caB]
print('apple chain A PLP atoms:',len(plpA))
# apple self-reference: chain B Gln83 min distance to chain A PLP
q83=[a for a in allB if a[1]=='83']
print('chain B res83 =',q83[0][2],' min dist to chain A PLP = %.2f A'%min(np.linalg.norm(a[4]-plpA,axis=1).min() for a in q83))

res={}
for q,path in [('Mouse Accsl',f'{D}/AF-Q3UX83.pdb'),('Human ACCSL',f'{D}/AF-Q4AC99.pdb'),('Human ACCS',f'{D}/AF-Q96QU6.pdb')]:
    ca,het,allat=parse_pdb(path)
    seq=seq_of(ca); C=np.array([r[3] for r in ca])
    seed=nw(seq,seqB); tm,R,tv,pairs,nc,rms=salign(C,cB,seed)
    hits=[]
    for ch,resi,resn,name,xyz,b in allat:
        p=R@xyz+tv; d=np.linalg.norm(p-plpA,axis=1).min()
        hits.append((resi,resn,name,d,b))
    hdf=pd.DataFrame(hits,columns=['resi','resn','atom','d','plddt'])
    per=hdf.groupby(['resi','resn'],as_index=False).agg(d=('d','min'),plddt=('plddt','max'))
    per=per.sort_values('d')
    close=per[per.d<8].copy()
    res[q]=(tm,rms,close)
    print(f'\n=== {q} superposed on apple chain B (TM={tm:.3f}, core RMSD={rms:.2f} A) ===')
    print('residues whose nearest atom is < 8 A from the PARTNER (chain A) PLP:')
    print(close.to_string(index=False) if len(close) else '  NONE')
    gl=per[(per.resn=='GLN')].sort_values('d').head(3)
    print('closest glutamines:', ', '.join(f'Q{r.resi} {r.d:.1f}A' for r in gl.itertuples()))
